title: cvpw handoff.json
description: The handoff CONTRACT: authored, reproducible, and never written by a tool. Measurements live in handoff.report.json, which is derived and is never an input to a stage (docs/SPEC.md A6). See docs/CONTRACTS.md §9.

id.description: `<lastShotId>|<firstShotId>` — the two shots the contract binds.

t.description: Time expression for the boundary instant.

mode.description: `pixel`: A's last frame and B's first frame must be near-identical, both sides reading this contract. `transition`: the shots overlap and the LATER shot owns drawing the transition.

contract.description: The shared state both sides MUST import and read. Neither side may hard-code these values (docs/SPEC.md C4).

env.description: Which environment/location module is on screen at the boundary.

layers.description: Bottom-to-top layer ids. Layer order is part of the contract because shadows and textures are per-layer.

fx.description: Per-frame post values at the boundary. Must be decayed: the outgoing block eases into this state over its last 0.3-0.5 s.

params.description: Any further shared values, by name. Values must be plain data so that both sides can read the same number.

note.description: Which values are shared and why, for the next author.
